objective_hud.doc: M2-UI-17/19: the on-screen objective line and the destination cue in the field. Rects are x, y, w, h at the 1920 x 1080 reference (multiples of 3); the panel's height is its least, and it grows for a wrapped line up to panel max_lines. The line slides in slide_px from the left over in_sec (reduced motion: a fade, no slide), holds hold_sec, then fades over out_sec. It shows when the objective changes, once when the field first takes input after a scene loads, and on demand with `action` (added to the InputMap when missing, through FieldInput.add_actions; remappable on the Controls page). It never shows while the field controller refuses input (cutscenes, conversations), while the tree is paused (menus) or in battle (a separate scene). cue: the destination marker over the objective's target when it is on screen, an edge arrow when it is not (inset edge_px from the screen edge), hidden within hide_within_m of the target; marker_lift_m raises it above the ground; distance words: near under near_m, a short walk under walk_m, else far. The distance words carry a label_outline_px dark outline, so they read over bright sky, sand and night water alike.
